nosotros.titulo: A family business with regulatory authority since 1990
nosotros.parrafo: Laboratorio Séance is a family business founded in 1990, a pioneer in contract cosmetics manufacturing in Argentina. Over more than 35 years, two generations of the same family have kept the same commitment: regulatory rigor, confidentiality and full ANMAT compliance in every product that passes through our laboratory.
nosotros.cita: «In this industry, problems are prevented before they appear. Our job is to anticipate them: prepare every dossier well and meet every regulation so your brand never has a headache with ANMAT.»
nosotros.epigrafe: Enrique Pelliza, founder of Séance, was invited by C5N as an industry reference to speak about the importance of registration and the authenticity of cosmetic products.
nosotros.imagenAlt: Enrique Pelliza, founder of Laboratorio Séance

faq.titulo: What we get asked the most

items.respuesta: We manufacture, import and register cosmetic, perfumery and household products in Argentina for brands and importers, with an active ANMAT authorization and full confidentiality.

items.pregunta: Are my formula and my brand protected?
items.respuesta: Yes. Every development is confidential and exclusive: we don't share or reuse formulas, and ownership of the brand and registration always stays with the client.

items.pregunta: Do I need to know how ANMAT works to work with you?
items.respuesta: No. We handle the entire regulatory side: we tell you what's needed, prepare the dossier and manage the registration end to end.

items.pregunta: How long does it take to register a cosmetic product in Argentina?
items.respuesta: Once the dossier is complete, ANMAT registration is immediate. The real timeline depends on preparing the documentation well, and that's exactly what we do for you.

items.pregunta: Do you manufacture for international brands without a structure in Argentina?
items.respuesta: Yes. Through our regulatory hosting we provide the authorized warehouse, technical direction and ANMAT registration so brands and importers from abroad can operate legally.
We're at Directorio 3548, Caseros, Buenos Aires, Argentina, with a facility authorized by ANMAT.
